nom: Clinique Clinique For Men Exfoliating Tonic

avis.texte: My skins looks and feels very clean ,highly recommend this product

avis.titre: Have been buying this project for years
avis.texte: I use this after cleansing my face and shaving. Leaves my skin squeaky clean, but doesn't dry it out. My wife got me started with this nearly 40 years ago when it was called "Scruffing Lotion". It really helped prevent ingrown hairs after a close shave, and still does.
The smell is horrible it smells like rubbing alcohol I bought this for my boyfriend and I don't feel like it's even safe to use on skin.
Smells Great, Cleanses My Skin By Wiping with a Cotton Ball...Feels So Cool In My Skin...Love It

avis.titre: I've repurchased this over and over.
avis.texte: I use this once in the morning and in the evening to clean my face. I've never went online to write a review on any product but I love this so much so I had to give it a great review. It really makes my skin feel smooth and completely clean. I haven't had a pimple in over a year since I started using this.
My dad likes this a lot. He notices a difference on his bald head.
My husband is using this item fir 10years! He said clinic is the best. No oily and clean feeling!

avis.titre: Great extra step for cleaning pores
avis.texte: I have used this product for over 20 years. It's a great extra step to clean the pores.

I bought this for my husband because of the reviews and he can tell the difference in his skin tone. He was suffering from occasional breakouts but this toner has reduced them. He's bald so the Clinique Rep told him to clean, tone and then shave. He uses the Charcoal Cleanser but not the moisturizer which he may try next.

avis.titre: An excellent product that I will continue to use.
avis.texte: Removes the oily film on my face without drying out the skin.
I use this product daily after a shave and shower. I have combination dry/oily skin, this stuff works great. I'm 30, it helps with light acne on my forehead, keeps my pores minimal.
This product is great if you have an oily skin. Face looks normal without the shinny look if used with the oil control mattifying moisturizer by Clinique. Great product, a little pricey though.
I have used this product for many years. I wish they kept the line for different skin types. It is a good product and has not disappointed.

avis.titre: Removes built up grime, shrinks pores
avis.texte: I use this toner once in the morning and once before going to bed, after using Clinique for Men oil control face wash bar and before using their oil control mattifying moisturizer. It leaves your skin feeling replenished after using face wash and removes all of the dirt from the day. It also neutralizes my face and prepares my skin for moisturizer. A great product overall, I can't go a day without it.
My husband uses this product every day. His skin is much clearer and less oily.

Great part of Clinique's 3-step system. My skin has never looked to good and free of almost all acne. There are occasional pimples here and there but for the most part no where near as what I had before using Clinique's line. My girlfriend complements me on my skin all the time.
I like everything about this toner except for the smell. It's not bad enough to not use, but it could be better. Other than the smell, it's great!

avis.titre: Scruffing is good for a face!
avis.texte: I bought this for my husband who has oily skin but shows signs of aging- fine lines, eye area wrinkles, thinning skin, and loosening of facial contours. He already uses Clinique cleansing bar for oily skin, which made him a believer in the product line. The next step was toning/exfoliating---hence, Scruffing Lotion! He says it feels cool and tingly at first and later slightly warm. His skin shows improved texture, tone and eveness of color. Also, occasional acne has not been seen in some time! His pillowcase shows less evidence of facial oils and stains which were once a laundry problem... I think the name of the product helps it be more acceptable to guys who don't want to be perceived as fussy regarding appearance. Just a healthy routine with lots of payoff- my man is happy!
this product works amazingly at reducing as well as removing pesky blackheads. The toner really helps reduce oil production as well as unclogging your pores allowing them to breathe easy.
just rinse the area around your mouth with water before kissing people, otherwise you can taste the alcohol residue
